data.uses_advised_against: Do not use in a manner inconsistent with the label.

supplier.name: W.W. Grainger, Inc.
supplier.address: 100 Grainger Parkway, Lake Forest, IL 60045, USA

classification: Specific target organ toxicity, single exposure, Category 3
hazard_statements: Causes severe skin burns and serious eye damage.

prevention: Wear chemical-splash goggles, chemical-resistant gloves, and protective footwear.
Avoid contact with eyes, skin, and clothing.
Do not breathe vapors or mists.
Use only in a well-ventilated area.
Do not eat, drink, or smoke while using the product.
Wash hands and affected areas thoroughly after handling.
Absorb spillage to prevent material damage.
Do not mix with ammonia, bleach, or other chlorinated compounds.
response: Immediately begin first aid and call a Poison Center or physician.
For eye exposure, rinse cautiously with water for at least 15 minutes.
For skin or hair exposure, remove contaminated clothing and rinse with water for at least 15 minutes.
If swallowed, rinse mouth, do not induce vomiting, and dilute with up to one cup of milk or water if conscious and tolerated.
If inhaled, move the person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing.
storage: Store tightly closed in the original corrosion-resistant plastic container.
disposal: Dispose of contents in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

data.other_hazards: Hazards not otherwise classified: not applicable.

general_advice: Start first aid immediately and call a Poison Center or physician.
data.eyes: Rinse cautiously with water for several minutes, remove contact lenses when present and easy to remove, and continue rinsing for at least 15 minutes.
data.skin: Immediately remove contaminated clothing and rinse skin or hair with water for at least 15 minutes. Wash clothing before reuse.
data.inhalation: Move the person to fresh air and keep comfortable for breathing. Call a Poison Center or physician if unwell.
data.ingestion: Rinse mouth. Do not induce vomiting. If conscious, dilute by drinking up to one cup of milk or water as tolerated.
data.most_important_symptoms_effects: Corrosive to all body tissues; may cause blindness without immediate first aid; harmful if swallowed; causes burns and serious damage to mouth, throat, and stomach.
data.immediate_medical_attention: Immediate Poison Center or physician contact is required.

suitable_extinguishing_media: Foam suitable for the surrounding fire
data.unsuitable_extinguishing_media: No restrictions based on the chemical hazards.
data.firefighter_protection: Wear self-contained breathing apparatus and full protective gear as conditions warrant.
special_methods: Select extinguisher and firefighting methods based on fire size and type.

emergency_procedures: Keep unprotected personnel away from the spill area.
environmental_precautions: Prevent entry into drains, storm sewers, or surface waterways.
containment: Dike larger spills to contain them.
Pump material into a labeled container or absorb with inert material.
cleanup: Wipe up small spills and rinse with water.
Rinse the area with water and follow normal cleanup procedures.

safe_handling: Train personnel on proper use, hazards, precautions, and first aid.
Avoid inhalation, ingestion, and contact with skin, eyes, and clothing.
Remove and wash contaminated clothing and footwear before reuse.
Handle empty containers carefully because residue may remain.
storage_conditions: Store tightly closed only in the original corrosion-resistant plastic container.
Store at ambient temperature in a dry area away from direct sunlight.
Keep away from food and drink.
Keep out of reach of children.

data.engineering_controls: No special engineering controls are required; general room ventilation is typically adequate.
data.eye_protection: Indirect-vented or non-vented safety goggles and an eyewash station.
data.hand_protection: Chemical-resistant protective gloves made of rubber or neoprene.
data.skin_body_protection: Rubber full-cover protective clothing and rubber boots when exposure is possible.
data.respiratory_protection: Use a suitable respirator if mists or vapors are not controlled by ventilation.
hygiene_measures: Wash hands and affected areas thoroughly after handling.

data.reactivity: Mixing with incompatible materials can release heat and hazardous gases.

symptoms.eyes: Serious eye damage, pain, redness, and watering; may cause blindness.
symptoms.skin: Severe skin burns with possible delayed pain, redness, and blistering.
symptoms.ingestion: Burns and serious damage to the mouth, throat, and stomach.
symptoms.inhalation: Corrosive effects to the nose, throat, and respiratory system.

data.acute_toxicity: Harmful if swallowed; no mixture LC50/LD50 test data are provided.
data.respiratory_or_skin_sensitization: No reportable skin or respiratory sensitizers.
data.carcinogenicity: No reportable ACGIH, IARC, NTP, or OSHA carcinogens.
